name: Shimo-Itabashi
tagline: Shinjuku in 16 minutes and Shibuya in 21 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000.
summary: The station is in Toshima City, served by Tobu Tojo Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 27 minutes to Otemachi, 16 minutes to Shinjuku, 21 minutes to Shibuya and 42 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. The station stands 25 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 8.1 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 25 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 23.3 m to 31.4 m, a difference of 8.1 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of less than 0.5 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 4 also fall inside the area, and the deepest projection is 0.5 to 3 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the small side for the 23 wards.

groceries.name: ヨークマート 下板橋店

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 3 clinics and 9 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 小川医院, about 12 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 高見産婦人科, about 16 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tobu Tojo Line.
congestion: Tobu Tojo Line runs at 131% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 北池袋→池袋, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥90,000 to ¥100,000 and 1K ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. 1LDK ¥160,000 to ¥170,000 and 2LDK ¥220,000 to ¥230,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

neighbours.lead: rent, commuting and the flood projection are all much the same.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Shimo-Itabashi. Itabashi has the JR Saikyo Line, a different set from Shimo-Itabashi. To Shinjuku, for instance, Itabashi is 5 minutes quicker. Rents, flood projections and the rest differ little.

People who want plenty of places to eat out
noiseSources: The 首都高速中央環状線 viaduct runs a short walk from the station. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 15 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the Tobu Tojo Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the low side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are lightly loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: The big roads are far enough that traffic noise is unlikely to bother you.
